        transform: translateX(20px);

        font-weight: bold;

    }

        font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 4cqw, 1rem);
    }

    .adaptative-text-big {
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 10cqw, 4rem);
    }

    .adaptative-text-table {
    font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 3cqw, 1rem);
    }

        text-align: center;

        /* Hidden by default */

        margin: auto;
        padding: 0;
        border: 1px solid #888;
        width: 50%;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);
        -webkit-animation-name: bounce;
        -webkit-animation-duration: 1s;
        animation-name: bounce;
        animation-duration: 1s
    }

    /* Add Animation */

        from {
            top: -300px;
            opacity: 0
        }

        to {
            top: 0;
            opacity: 1
        }
    }

        from {
            top: -300px;
            opacity: 0
        }

            top: 0;
            opacity: 1
        }
